title: State v. Y.R. & Ors. (Transit Corridor Abduction Case)
citation: Special Sessions Court (Judgment confirmed by High Court appellate bench - Anonymized Archive)
confidence_note: High (Beyond Reasonable Doubt, confirmed on appeal with forensic corroboration)

ground_truth.culprit_summary: Suspect Y.R. and co-accused (cab driver and accomplices)
ground_truth.rationale: Forensic blood match in Qualis cab, ATM CCTV cash withdrawal, Sec 164 CrPC judicial confession by approver.

hypotheses.label: Suspect Y.R. & Co-accused
hypotheses.statement: Cab driver Y.R. and accomplices abducted the victim in Qualis cab, used her ATM cards, and committed the assault.

hypotheses.label: Unknown Highway Syndicate
hypotheses.statement: An opportunistic inter-state highway gang hijacked the victim at transit bypass; cab driver was unrelated.

hypotheses.label: Workplace Colleague
hypotheses.statement: A disgruntled corporate colleague arranged the abduction using a hired private vehicle.

H1.mo_description: Suspect and accomplices operated a shared vehicle pretending to be official route transport. Targeted lone female corporate employees.

exhibits.name: State Bank of India ATM CCTV Footage & Transaction Log
exhibits.text: SBI ATM CCTV camera at Talegaon Dabhade timestamped 22:45 IST clearly captures Yogesh Raut wearing a dark jacket withdrawing Rs 20,000 using the victim's debit card. Face match positive at 94.2% match against police dossier.

exhibits.name: Vodafone Cellular Tower BTS Call Detail Records
exhibits.text: Cell tower BTS logs for IMEI matching Yogesh Raut's handset move synchronously with victim's mobile tower pings from Kharadi bypass to Talegaon Dabhade between 20:15 and 23:30 IST on the incident night.

exhibits.name: State Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) Qualis Cab Inspection
exhibits.text: Luminol testing of vehicle Qualis MH-12-CR-8692 revealed latent bloodstains on rear seat upholstery. DNA profiling matched victim's reference blood sample with random match probability 1 in 1.4 billion. Front passenger seat hairs matched Yogesh Raut.

exhibits.name: Judicial Confession of Approver Rajesh Chaudhari
exhibits.text: Judicial confession recorded under Section 164 CrPC before Metropolitan Magistrate detailing the sequence of kidnapping, ATM pin extraction, and murder executed under Yogesh Raut's leadership.

adversarial_exhibit.name: Planted Highway Gang Receipt
adversarial_exhibit.text: Unverified handwritten scrap allegedly found on highway shoulder mentioning an unknown inter-state gang planning Kharadi robbery.
